```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120
)
has <- function(x) !is.null(x)
```

*Generated by [sandtablR](https://github.com/cttir/sandtablR). The domain
model follows the TDSC tabletop exercise as described in Achatz et al. (2023),
doi:10.1007/s00068-022-02217-1. sandtablR is a generic re-implementation built
from published specifications and is not affiliated with the TDSC course.*

## Scenario

```{r scenario-none, eval = !has(params$scenario), results = "asis"}
cat("No scenario was built in this session.\n")
```

```{r scenario, eval = has(params$scenario)}
sc <- params$scenario
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Field = c("Name", "Casualties", "Seed"),
    Value = c(sc$meta$name, nrow(sc$cohort), sc$meta$seed %||% NA)
  ),
  caption = "Scenario"
)
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Area = names(sc$resources),
    Capacity = unlist(sc$resources, use.names = FALSE)
  ),
  caption = "Board capacity"
)
sandtablR::sdt_plot_triage_mix(sc)
```

```{r cohort-summary, eval = has(params$scenario)}
knitr::kable(summary(params$scenario), caption = "Triage by therapy concept")
```

## Simulation

```{r run-none, eval = !has(params$run), results = "asis"}
cat("No simulation was run in this session.\n")
```

```{r run, eval = has(params$run)}
run <- params$run
knitr::kable(
  summary(run, reference = TRUE),
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste0(
    "End-of-game location, against the published reference. ",
    run$meta$replications, " replication(s) over ", run$meta$horizon,
    " minutes."
  )
)
sandtablR::sdt_plot_end_state(run)
```

```{r flow, eval = has(params$run)}
sandtablR::sdt_plot_flow(run)
```

```{r sequences, eval = has(params$run)}
sandtablR::sdt_plot_sequences(run, type = "distribution")
```

```{r consistency, eval = has(params$run)}
consistency <- sandtablR::sdt_decision_consistency(run)
knitr::kable(
  utils::head(consistency[order(consistency$consistency), ], 10),
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Ten least consistently routed casualties"
)
```

## Model bench

```{r bench-none, eval = !has(params$bench), results = "asis"}
cat("No models were trained in this session.\n")
```

```{r bench, eval = has(params$bench)}
knitr::kable(
  params$bench, digits = 3,
  caption = "Held-out performance by engine"
)
```

```{r best-roc, eval = has(params$models) && length(params$models) > 0}
auc <- params$bench[params$bench$.metric == "roc_auc", ]
best <- auc$engine[which.max(auc$.estimate)]
if (length(best) && best %in% names(params$models)) {
  sandtablR::sdt_roc(params$models[[best]])
}
```

## Explanations

```{r explain, eval = has(params$models) && length(params$models) > 0}
ready <- requireNamespace("DALEX", quietly = TRUE) &&
  requireNamespace("DALEXtra", quietly = TRUE)
if (ready) {
  auc <- params$bench[params$bench$.metric == "roc_auc", ]
  best <- auc$engine[which.max(auc$.estimate)]
  if (length(best) && best %in% names(params$models)) {
    sandtablR::sdt_importance(params$models[[best]], n_permutations = 10)
  }
} else {
  cat("Install DALEX and DALEXtra for explanations.\n")
}
```
